newsitem.title: USA: Air France unveiles California sale fares.
newsitem.headline: Air France unveiles California sale fares.

text.p: Air France Wednesday unveiled its "Winter Sale Fares" from California to more than 50 European cities with rates as low as $254 each way, based on a round trip purchase.
The mid-week winter fares, available for departures from November 1 to March 31, are being offered from both Los Angeles and San Francisco.
Sample one-way fares are $254 to Paris; $279 to Nice and Lyon; and $292 to Rome, Frankfurt, Oslo, Milan, Madrid and Geneva, the company said.
Other sale fares are available for September and October departures.
Tickets, which are non-refundable, must be bought by August 7 and travel must be completed by April 2, 1998, the company said.
